name: bcl-convert / bcl2fastq
aim: Converts Illumina base calls to FASTQ and demultiplexes samples by index.

name: Dorado
aim: Oxford Nanopore basecaller; converts raw current signal to bases and calls modified bases (5mC, 5hmC, 6mA). Basecaller model version strongly affects accuracy.

name: FastQC + MultiQC
aim: Per-sample read quality reports (FastQC) aggregated across samples and tools into one report (MultiQC). Used in every sequencing omics.

name: fastp
aim: Fast all-in-one adapter trimming, quality filtering and QC report.

name: BWA-MEM2
aim: Short-read DNA aligner using an FM-index with seed-and-extend; the default for GATK pipelines; same output as BWA-MEM, faster.

name: Bowtie2
aim: Fast gapped short-read aligner; standard for ChIP-seq and ATAC-seq.

name: minimap2
aim: Versatile aligner for long reads (PacBio, ONT), assemblies and spliced RNA; also short reads.

name: SAMtools / BCFtools / HTSlib
aim: Core utilities for sorting, indexing, filtering and viewing SAM/BAM/CRAM and VCF/BCF files; also a simple variant caller.

name: Picard / GATK MarkDuplicates
aim: Identifies PCR and optical duplicates; collects alignment, insert-size and hybrid-selection metrics.

name: GATK HaplotypeCaller
aim: Local de novo haplotype assembly plus pair-HMM likelihoods to call SNVs and indels; gVCF + joint genotyping for cohorts.

name: DeepVariant
aim: CNN classifier on pileup images; top accuracy in precisionFDA challenges for short and long reads. DeepTrio for families.

name: Clair3
aim: Deep-learning small-variant caller optimised for long reads (ONT, PacBio).

name: Strelka2
aim: Fast germline and somatic small-variant caller with tiered haplotype model.

name: FreeBayes
aim: Bayesian haplotype-based caller; flexible ploidy, pooled samples.

name: DRAGEN
aim: Illumina's hardware-accelerated pipeline for alignment and calling of SNVs, CNVs, SVs and repeat expansions; commercial.

name: NVIDIA Parabricks
aim: GPU-accelerated implementations of BWA-MEM, GATK and DeepVariant.

name: GLnexus
aim: Scalable joint genotyping of gVCFs, typically for DeepVariant cohorts.

name: Mutect2
aim: GATK somatic SNV/indel caller with tumour-normal mode, panel of normals, orientation-bias and contamination filters; mitochondrial mode.

name: VarDict / LoFreq
aim: Sensitive low-frequency variant callers for targeted panels and amplicons.

name: Manta
aim: Short-read SV and large indel caller using paired and split reads with local assembly.

name: DELLY
aim: SV caller integrating paired-end, split-read and read-depth signals; germline and somatic.

name: GRIDSS2
aim: Assembly-based breakend caller; high precision for somatic rearrangements (with PURPLE/LINX).

name: Sniffles2
aim: Long-read SV caller with population-scale merging and mosaic SV detection.

name: cuteSV / pbsv
aim: Long-read SV callers (cuteSV general; pbsv from PacBio).

name: Truvari
aim: Compares SV call sets to truth sets with size and sequence similarity matching.

name: hap.py / vcfeval
aim: Standard comparison of small-variant calls to GIAB truth sets with haplotype-aware matching and stratification.

name: CNVkit
aim: Copy number from targeted or exome sequencing using on- and off-target read depth.

name: ASCAT / FACETS / PURPLE
aim: Allele-specific copy number with tumour purity and ploidy estimation.

name: GISTIC2
aim: Identifies significantly recurrent copy-number alterations across a tumour cohort.

name: ExpansionHunter
aim: Genotypes short tandem repeat expansions (e.g. FMR1, C9orf72) from short reads.

name: Ensembl VEP
aim: Predicts variant consequences per transcript and adds frequencies, predictions and plugins (CADD, SpliceAI, AlphaMissense).

name: ANNOVAR
aim: Fast gene-, region- and filter-based variant annotation against many databases.

name: SnpEff / SnpSift
aim: Variant effect annotation and VCF filtering; many species.

name: CADD
aim: Genome-wide deleteriousness score integrating many annotations (PHRED-scaled).

name: REVEL / BayesDel
aim: Ensemble missense pathogenicity scores with ClinGen-calibrated thresholds.

name: AlphaMissense
aim: Missense pathogenicity predictions for all possible human missense variants, from an AlphaFold-derived model.

name: EVE / ESM-1v
aim: Unsupervised evolutionary and protein-language-model variant effect predictors, trained without clinical labels.

name: SpliceAI
aim: Deep CNN that predicts splice-site gain and loss from 10 kb of sequence context.

name: Exomiser
aim: Ranks variants and genes by combining pathogenicity, frequency, inheritance and HPO phenotype similarity.

name: InterVar / Franklin
aim: Semi-automated ACMG/AMP criteria evaluation.

name: PLINK 2
aim: Genotype QC, association testing, LD, PCA; the Swiss army knife of statistical genetics.

name: REGENIE
aim: Whole-genome regression for biobank-scale GWAS of quantitative and binary traits; fast, controls relatedness.

name: SAIGE
aim: Mixed-model association for unbalanced binary traits and rare-variant tests; SAIGE-QTL for single-cell.

name: Beagle / Minimac4 / IMPUTE5
aim: Imputes untyped variants from reference haplotype panels; often run via the Michigan or TOPMed servers.

name: SHAPEIT5 / Eagle2
aim: Statistical phasing of genotypes into haplotypes at biobank scale.

name: WhatsHap
aim: Read-based phasing using long or linked reads.

name: LDSC
aim: LD score regression: SNP heritability, genetic correlation, confounding vs polygenicity; S-LDSC for annotation enrichment.

name: SuSiE / FINEMAP
aim: Bayesian fine-mapping giving credible sets and posterior inclusion probabilities for causal variants.

name: PRS-CS / LDpred2
aim: Bayesian polygenic score construction from GWAS summary statistics; PRS-CSx for multi-ancestry.

name: MutSigCV / dNdScv
aim: Detect genes mutated more than expected by background (MutSigCV) or by dN/dS selection (dNdScv).

name: SigProfiler
aim: Extracts and assigns COSMIC mutational signatures (SBS, DBS, ID, CN).

name: PyClone-VI
aim: Infers clonal populations from variant allele fractions accounting for copy number and purity.

name: hifiasm
aim: Haplotype-resolved de novo assembly from PacBio HiFi, with Hi-C or trio phasing; ONT ultra-long integration.

name: Flye / Shasta
aim: Long-read assemblers for noisier reads (Flye: repeat graphs; Shasta: fast run-length assembly).

name: Verkko
aim: Telomere-to-telomere hybrid assembly from HiFi and ultra-long ONT.

name: SPAdes
aim: De Bruijn graph assembler for bacterial genomes, single-cell and metagenomes (metaSPAdes).

name: BUSCO / Merqury / QUAST
aim: Assembly completeness (conserved genes), k-mer quality and contiguity statistics.

name: vg / minigraph-Cactus / PGGB
aim: Build variation graphs and align reads to them (vg giraffe), reducing reference bias.

name: IGV
aim: Interactive viewer for alignments, variants and tracks; indispensable for checking calls by eye.

name: Aldy / PharmCAT / Cyrius
aim: Star-allele calling for pharmacogenes (CYP2D6 including structural variants) and guideline-based reporting.

name: Bismark
aim: Bisulfite-aware aligner (Bowtie2-based) and methylation extractor; the most widely used WGBS/RRBS tool.

name: bwa-meth
aim: Fast, accurate bisulfite read aligner based on BWA-MEM; pairs with MethylDackel for extraction.

name: MethylDackel
aim: Extracts per-CpG methylation and M-bias from bisulfite alignments.

name: modkit
aim: Summarises modified-base calls (5mC, 5hmC, 6mA) from nanopore BAMs into per-site tables.

name: minfi / SeSAMe
aim: Preprocessing, normalisation, QC and differential analysis for Illumina 450K/EPIC arrays.

name: ChAMP
aim: Integrated array analysis pipeline: QC, normalisation, DMP/DMR, cell-type correction, CNV.

name: DSS / dmrseq / bsseq
aim: Statistical tests for differentially methylated loci and regions from sequencing data, modelling coverage and smoothing.

name: methylKit
aim: Per-base and tiled differential methylation for bisulfite sequencing.

name: DMRcate
aim: Kernel-smoothed DMR calling for arrays and sequencing.

name: EpiDISH
aim: Estimates cell-type proportions from methylation profiles (reference-based).

name: methylclock / DunedinPACE
aim: Computes epigenetic age and pace-of-ageing estimates from methylation data.

name: MACS2 / MACS3
aim: Model-based peak caller for ChIP-seq and ATAC-seq; sharp and broad modes.

name: Genrich / HMMRATAC
aim: ATAC-seq-aware peak callers (Genrich: replicate-aware; HMMRATAC: nucleosome-aware HMM).

name: SEACR
aim: Sparse-enrichment peak caller designed for CUT&RUN and CUT&Tag.

name: SICER2 / epic2
aim: Broad-domain callers for histone marks such as H3K27me3 and H3K36me3.

name: IDR
aim: Irreproducible Discovery Rate: ranks peaks by replicate consistency (ENCODE standard).

name: deepTools
aim: bigWig generation, normalisation, heatmaps and profiles around features; QC (fingerprint, correlation).

name: DiffBind
aim: Differential ChIP/ATAC peaks across conditions using DESeq2 or edgeR.

name: csaw
aim: Window-based de novo differential binding without predefined peaks.

name: HOMER
aim: De novo and known motif enrichment, peak annotation and many ChIP/ATAC utilities.

name: MEME Suite
aim: Motif discovery (MEME, STREME), enrichment (SEA, AME) and scanning (FIMO).

name: chromVAR
aim: Per-sample or per-cell TF motif accessibility deviations from sparse ATAC data.

name: TOBIAS / HINT-ATAC
aim: TF footprinting in ATAC-seq: corrects Tn5 bias and estimates TF occupancy.

name: ChIPseeker / GREAT
aim: Annotate peaks to genes and features; GREAT tests functional enrichment of distal regions.

name: ChromHMM
aim: Multivariate HMM that segments the genome into chromatin states from multiple marks.

name: ABC model / ENCODE-rE2G
aim: Predicts enhancer-to-gene regulation from activity and contact; rE2G is trained on CRISPR perturbations.

name: Juicer / HiC-Pro / distiller
aim: Process Hi-C reads into normalised contact matrices (.hic or .cool).

name: cooler / cooltools
aim: Storage and analysis of contact matrices: compartments, insulation, expected decay, pileups.

name: HiCExplorer
aim: Full Hi-C toolkit: matrix building, TAD calling, loop detection, plotting.

name: Mustache / HiCCUPS / chromosight
aim: Detect chromatin loops from contact matrices.

name: ArchR
aim: End-to-end scATAC analysis: QC, iterative LSI, clustering, peaks, gene scores, peak-to-gene links, trajectories.

name: Signac
aim: Seurat-integrated scATAC and multiome analysis.

name: SnapATAC2
aim: Fast, scalable scATAC analysis with matrix-free spectral embedding.

name: Enformer / Borzoi
aim: Deep models predicting expression and chromatin tracks from DNA sequence; used for in-silico variant effects.

name: STAR
aim: Ultrafast splice-aware aligner; two-pass mode for novel junctions; STARsolo for single-cell. Needs ~32 GB RAM for human.

name: HISAT2
aim: Memory-efficient splice-aware aligner using hierarchical graph FM-index.

name: salmon
aim: Transcript quantification by selective alignment with bias correction; use a decoy-aware index.

name: kallisto
aim: Pseudoalignment-based transcript quantification; very fast; kallisto|bustools for single-cell.

name: RSEM
aim: EM-based gene and isoform quantification from alignments; used in ENCODE and TCGA pipelines.

name: featureCounts
aim: Fast read counting per gene or feature from BAM files (Subread package).

name: tximport / tximeta
aim: Import transcript-level estimates and summarise to gene level with offsets for DE.

name: nf-core/rnaseq
aim: Community pipeline: QC, trimming, STAR/salmon, extensive QC, counts; reproducible on any infrastructure.

name: RSeQC / Qualimap
aim: RNA-seq specific QC: strandedness, gene-body coverage, junction saturation, read distribution.

name: DESeq2
aim: Negative binomial GLM with dispersion and fold-change shrinkage; median-of-ratios normalisation.

name: edgeR
aim: Negative binomial GLMs with quasi-likelihood F-tests; TMM normalisation; flexible designs.

name: limma-voom
aim: Linear models on log-CPM with precision weights and empirical Bayes; fast, excellent for complex designs.

name: dream (variancePartition)
aim: Linear mixed models for repeated measures (e.g. multiple samples per donor).

name: sva / ComBat-seq / RUVSeq
aim: Estimate and remove known or unknown batch effects (surrogate variables, empirical Bayes, control genes).

name: clusterProfiler
aim: Over-representation and GSEA for GO, KEGG, Reactome, MSigDB with visualisation.

name: fgsea / GSEA
aim: Fast preranked gene set enrichment; GSEA is the Broad desktop tool with MSigDB.

name: g:Profiler / Enrichr
aim: Web-based functional enrichment across many databases.

name: GSVA / singscore
aim: Per-sample gene set scores for downstream modelling.

name: decoupleR + PROGENy / CollecTRI
aim: Infers TF and pathway activities from expression using footprint gene sets.

name: WGCNA
aim: Weighted gene co-expression modules and their association with traits; needs ≥ ~20 samples.

name: rMATS
aim: Event-based differential alternative splicing (SE, A5SS, A3SS, MXE, RI) with replicates.

name: LeafCutter
aim: Annotation-free intron clustering for differential splicing and sQTL mapping.

name: MAJIQ
aim: Local splicing variations including complex events, with Bayesian PSI quantification.

name: SUPPA2
aim: Fast PSI and differential splicing from transcript quantifications.

name: DEXSeq
aim: Differential exon usage with GLMs on exon bins.

name: IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR
aim: Detects isoform switches and predicts their functional consequences (domains, NMD, coding potential).

name: StringTie2
aim: Reference-guided or de novo transcript assembly from short or long reads.

name: IsoQuant / Bambu / FLAIR
aim: Isoform discovery and quantification from long-read RNA-seq.

name: SQANTI3
aim: Structural classification, QC and filtering of long-read transcript models.

name: STAR-Fusion / Arriba
aim: Detect gene fusions from RNA-seq chimeric reads; top performers in benchmarks.

name: CIBERSORTx / MuSiC / BayesPrism
aim: Estimate cell-type proportions (and cell-type expression) from bulk RNA-seq using single-cell references.

name: miRDeep2
aim: Known and novel miRNA identification and quantification from small RNA-seq.

name: Trinity
aim: De novo transcriptome assembly for species without a reference genome.

name: tensorQTL / QTLtools
aim: Fast cis and trans molecular QTL mapping (GPU for tensorQTL), permutation-based significance.

name: Cell Ranger
aim: 10x Genomics pipeline: demultiplexing, alignment, barcode and UMI counting for RNA, ATAC, VDJ, Multiome, Visium/Xenium variants.

name: STARsolo
aim: Cell Ranger-compatible counting inside STAR; faster; spliced/unspliced matrices for velocity.

name: alevin-fry / simpleaf
aim: Accurate, memory-efficient single-cell quantification with salmon's selective alignment.

name: kallisto | bustools
aim: Very fast pseudoalignment-based single-cell counting (kb-python).

name: Scanpy
aim: Core scverse toolkit: QC, normalisation, PCA, neighbours, Leiden, UMAP, DE; AnnData-based; scales to millions of cells.

name: Seurat
aim: Most widely used R framework: QC, integration (CCA, RPCA), WNN multimodal, spatial, reference mapping (Azimuth).

name: Bioconductor OSCA (scran, scater)
aim: SingleCellExperiment-based workflow with pooled normalisation and rigorous statistics.

name: SoupX / CellBender / DecontX
aim: Estimate and remove ambient RNA contamination; CellBender also calls cells using a deep generative model.

name: scDblFinder / DoubletFinder / Scrublet
aim: Identify droplets with two cells by comparing to simulated artificial doublets.

name: demuxlet / souporcell / vireo
aim: Assign cells to donors by genotype in pooled designs; also detect inter-donor doublets.

name: sctransform
aim: Regularised negative binomial regression; residuals as normalised values.

name: Harmony
aim: Iterative soft-clustering correction of PCA embeddings; fast and strong for simple batch structures.

name: scVI / scANVI
aim: Variational autoencoders for integration (scVI) and semi-supervised label-aware integration (scANVI); top in atlas-level benchmarks.

name: Scanorama / BBKNN / fastMNN
aim: Mutual-nearest-neighbour and graph-based batch integration methods.

name: LIGER
aim: Integrative NMF separating shared and dataset-specific factors; also cross-modality.

name: CellTypist
aim: Logistic-regression models for automated immune and multi-tissue cell-type annotation.

name: SingleR
aim: Reference-based annotation by correlation with labelled bulk or single-cell references.

name: Azimuth / scArches
aim: Map query cells onto reference atlases without re-integrating everything.

name: scCODA / propeller / miloR
aim: Test changes in cell-type or neighbourhood abundance between conditions.

name: muscat / pseudobulk DESeq2
aim: Multi-sample, multi-condition DE using pseudobulk or mixed models (donor as replicate).

name: Monocle 3
aim: Learns principal graphs for trajectories and pseudotime; graph-based DE.

name: Slingshot
aim: Lineage inference with simultaneous principal curves over clusters; a top performer in benchmarks.

name: PAGA
aim: Partition-based graph abstraction preserving global topology.

name: scVelo
aim: Estimates RNA velocity via a dynamical model of splicing kinetics.

name: CellRank 2
aim: Markov-chain fate probabilities from velocity, pseudotime, real time or metabolic labels.

name: CellPhoneDB
aim: Ligand–receptor inference with multi-subunit complexes and permutation testing.

name: CellChat
aim: Communication networks with signalling pathway-level summaries and visualisation.

name: NicheNet / LIANA+
aim: Links ligands to downstream target genes (NicheNet); LIANA+ combines many methods and resources consistently.

name: pySCENIC / SCENIC+
aim: Infers regulons from co-expression and motifs; SCENIC+ adds chromatin accessibility (eRegulons).

name: CellOracle
aim: GRN inference with in-silico TF perturbation simulation.

name: Geneformer / scGPT
aim: Transformer models pre-trained on tens of millions of cells for annotation and perturbation tasks; check against simple baselines.

name: Squidpy
aim: Spatial graphs, neighbourhood enrichment, co-occurrence, spatial autocorrelation, image features.

name: SpatialData
aim: Unified storage and alignment of multi-platform spatial data (images, shapes, points, tables).

name: Giotto Suite
aim: End-to-end spatial analysis across technologies.

name: cell2location
aim: Bayesian mapping of single-cell types onto spatial spots; top in deconvolution benchmarks.

name: RCTD (spacexr)
aim: Robust cell-type decomposition accounting for platform effects.

name: Tangram
aim: Maps single cells to space by aligning expression; predicts unmeasured genes.

name: BayesSpace / SpaGCN / BANKSY
aim: Identify spatial domains using neighbourhood-aware clustering.

name: SPARK-X / nnSVG / SpatialDE
aim: Detect genes with spatial expression patterns.

name: Cellpose / Baysor / StarDist
aim: Segment cells and nuclei in images, or from transcript positions (Baysor).

name: CellxGENE Census
aim: Programmatic access to tens of millions of standardised single cells.

name: ThermoRawFileParser / msconvert
aim: Convert vendor raw files to open mzML (ProteoWizard msconvert covers most vendors).

name: MaxQuant
aim: DDA label-free (MaxLFQ), SILAC and TMT; Andromeda search engine; match between runs. Perseus for downstream.

name: FragPipe (MSFragger)
aim: Ultrafast open and closed searches, PTMs, glyco, DIA (with DIA-NN), TMT; Philosopher FDR control.

name: DIA-NN
aim: Neural-network-based DIA processing, library-free or library-based; widely benchmarked as top performer.

name: Spectronaut
aim: Commercial DIA software with directDIA library-free workflows.

name: Skyline
aim: Targeted SRM/PRM/DIA method building and quantification; also small molecules.

name: Proteome Discoverer
aim: Thermo's commercial workflow platform (SEQUEST HT, Percolator).

name: OpenMS / Sage
aim: Open-source modular MS processing (OpenMS) and a very fast open search engine (Sage).

name: Percolator / MS²Rescore
aim: Semi-supervised rescoring of PSMs; MS²Rescore adds predicted spectra and retention time features.

name: Prosit / AlphaPeptDeep
aim: Predict fragment intensities and retention times for in-silico spectral libraries.

name: MSstats / MSstatsTMT
aim: Linear mixed models for protein-level differential abundance from DDA, DIA, SRM and TMT.

name: limma / DEqMS / proDA
aim: Moderated tests (DEqMS uses peptide counts; proDA models missing values probabilistically).

name: Perseus
aim: Point-and-click downstream analysis for MaxQuant output: imputation, tests, clustering.

name: PTM-SEA / KSEA / Kinase Library
aim: Infer kinase and pathway activity from phosphosite changes.

name: OlinkAnalyze
aim: QC, normalisation (bridging) and statistics for Olink NPX data.

name: AlphaFold DB / ColabFold
aim: Predicted structures for most known proteins; ColabFold runs AlphaFold2 with fast MSA generation.

name: AlphaFold3 / Boltz / Chai-1
aim: Complexes of proteins, nucleic acids, ligands and modifications.

name: ESMFold / ESM-2
aim: Single-sequence structure prediction and embeddings from protein language models.

name: STRING
aim: Integrated functional and physical protein association networks with confidence scores.

name: Cytoscape
aim: Network visualisation and analysis with apps (stringApp, ClueGO, enrichmentMap).

name: SAINTexpress / CompPASS
aim: Score bait–prey interactions in AP-MS and proximity labelling against controls.

name: MSFragger-Glyco / pGlyco3
aim: Identify intact glycopeptides and glycan compositions.

name: TopPIC / ProSight
aim: Proteoform identification from intact protein spectra.

name: PTXQC
aim: Automated QC report for MaxQuant outputs.

name: XCMS
aim: centWave peak detection, retention-time alignment and grouping for LC-MS; XCMS Online for web use.

name: MZmine 3
aim: Modular open-source LC-MS/GC-MS/IMS processing with feature-based molecular networking export.

name: MS-DIAL
aim: Untargeted LC-MS and GC-MS, DIA MS/MS deconvolution, lipid annotation with large libraries.

name: CAMERA / MS-FLO
aim: Annotate isotopes, adducts and in-source fragments to reduce feature redundancy.

name: SERRF / QC-RLSC
aim: Correct signal drift and batch effects using pooled QC samples.

name: GNPS / FBMN
aim: Spectral library search and molecular networking; feature-based networking couples with MZmine/MS-DIAL.

name: SIRIUS + CSI:FingerID + CANOPUS
aim: Molecular formula from isotopes and fragmentation trees, structure database ranking and compound-class prediction.

name: MetFrag / MS-FINDER
aim: In-silico fragmentation scoring of candidate structures.

name: MetaboAnalyst
aim: Web platform for statistics, enrichment, pathway, biomarker and multi-omics analysis.

name: mummichog
aim: Pathway activity from untargeted m/z features without prior identification.

name: ropls / mixOmics (PLS-DA)
aim: PCA, PLS-DA and OPLS-DA with cross-validation and permutation tests.

name: LipidSearch / LipidXplorer / LipidMatch
aim: Lipid identification and quantification from LC-MS and shotgun lipidomics.

name: IsoCor / AccuCor / INCA
aim: Natural-abundance correction (IsoCor, AccuCor) and 13C metabolic flux analysis (INCA).

name: COBRApy / RAVEN
aim: Constraint-based genome-scale metabolic modelling (FBA, FVA) and context-specific models from omics.

name: NMRProcFlow / BATMAN
aim: NMR spectra processing, binning and metabolite quantification.

name: Cardinal / METASPACE
aim: Mass spectrometry imaging analysis and spatial metabolite annotation.

name: Skyline (small molecule)
aim: Builds MRM/PRM methods and integrates targeted lipid peaks with internal-standard normalisation and calibration curves; free and vendor-neutral.

name: LipidCreator
aim: Generates lipid MRM transition lists and spectral libraries for any class, adducts and fragments, exported directly to Skyline.

name: MultiQuant / SCIEX OS
aim: Vendor software for integrating and quantifying MRM data on SCIEX triple quadrupoles and QTRAPs.

name: TargetLynx / TraceFinder
aim: Vendor targeted quantification for Waters and Thermo instruments.

name: MRMkit
aim: Open-source automated peak integration, QC-based normalisation and batch correction for large MRM datasets.

name: LipidSearch
aim: Commercial identification and relative quantification of lipids from high-resolution LC-MS/MS.

name: MS-DIAL (lipidomics)
aim: Untargeted lipid annotation with large in-silico MS/MS libraries; supports ion mobility and EAD spectra.

name: LipidXplorer / LipidHunter
aim: Rule-based lipid identification for shotgun (LipidXplorer) and LC-MS (LipidHunter) data.

name: Lipid Data Analyzer (LDA)
aim: Rule-based identification and quantification with isotope correction for LC-MS lipidomics.

name: LICAR / isotope correction scripts
aim: Type I and type II isotope correction for lipid species with overlapping isotopes.

name: Goslin / LipidLynxX
aim: Parse and convert lipid names between dialects and annotation levels to current LIPID MAPS shorthand.

name: lipidr
aim: Normalisation, QC, differential analysis and lipid-set enrichment by class and chain properties.

name: LipidSuite
aim: Web interface to lipidr-style analysis for targeted and untargeted lipidomics.

name: LION/web
aim: Lipid ontology enrichment: tests membrane, chemical and functional properties of changed lipids.

name: Lipid Mini-On
aim: Enrichment of lipid classes, chain lengths and saturation from lipid names.

name: BioPAN
aim: LIPID MAPS tool that infers active or suppressed lipid pathways and candidate enzymes from species ratios.

name: Lipid Maps Structure Database (LMSD)
aim: Curated lipid structures, classification and nomenclature.

name: QIIME 2
aim: Reproducible end-to-end amplicon analysis with provenance tracking.

name: DADA2
aim: Error-model-based inference of exact amplicon sequence variants (ASVs).

name: Deblur
aim: Fast positive-filtering ASV inference (QIIME 2 plugin).

name: PICRUSt2
aim: Predicts metagenome functional content from 16S ASVs (predictions, not measurements).

name: Kraken 2 + Bracken
aim: k-mer-based read classification with abundance re-estimation.

name: MetaPhlAn 4
aim: Clade-specific marker-gene profiling including uncultured species-level genome bins.

name: HUMAnN 3
aim: Gene family and pathway abundances from metagenomes and metatranscriptomes.

name: MEGAHIT / metaSPAdes / metaFlye
aim: Assemble metagenomic reads (MEGAHIT memory-efficient; metaSPAdes accurate; metaFlye for long reads).

name: MetaBAT 2 / SemiBin2 / VAMB
aim: Group contigs into metagenome-assembled genomes using coverage and composition (VAMB, SemiBin: deep learning).

name: CheckM2
aim: Machine-learning estimates of MAG completeness and contamination.

name: GTDB-Tk
aim: Assigns standardised GTDB taxonomy to genomes and MAGs.

name: StrainPhlAn / inStrain
aim: Strain-level tracking and population genomics within samples.

name: phyloseq / mia
aim: Data structures and analysis for microbiome tables, trees and metadata.

name: ANCOM-BC2 / ALDEx2 / LinDA
aim: Compositionally aware differential abundance testing.

name: MaAsLin 2
aim: Multivariable association between microbial features and metadata.

name: vegan
aim: Diversity, ordination and PERMANOVA (adonis2) for community data.

name: decontam
aim: Identify contaminant sequences using negative controls or DNA concentration.

name: nf-core/mag / ampliseq
aim: Community pipelines for metagenome assembly and binning, and amplicon analysis.

name: MOFA+
aim: Bayesian group factor analysis; shared and layer-specific factors with variance explained; handles missing views and multiple groups.

name: mixOmics (DIABLO)
aim: Sparse multi-block PLS-DA for multi-omics biomarker discovery with cross-validation.

name: SNF
aim: Similarity network fusion of patient networks per layer; spectral clustering for subtypes.

name: iClusterBayes
aim: Bayesian latent variable model for integrative subtype discovery.

name: IntNMF / MOVICS
aim: Integrative NMF clustering; MOVICS wraps many multi-omics clustering algorithms.

name: MCIA (omicade4 / nipalsMCIA)
aim: Multiple co-inertia analysis projecting layers into a shared space.

name: RGCCA
aim: Regularised generalised canonical correlation analysis for multi-block data.

name: Seurat WNN
aim: Weighted nearest neighbours: learns per-cell modality weights for joint clustering (CITE-seq, Multiome).

name: totalVI / MultiVI
aim: Deep generative models for RNA+protein (totalVI) and RNA+ATAC with mosaic support (MultiVI).

name: GLUE
aim: Graph-linked unified embedding of unpaired modalities using a regulatory prior graph.

name: MIDAS / StabMap
aim: Integrate datasets with partially overlapping modalities.

name: muon / MuData
aim: Multimodal container and analysis tools in the scverse ecosystem.

name: MultiAssayExperiment
aim: Bioconductor container coordinating multiple assays on overlapping samples.

name: coloc / coloc-SuSiE
aim: Bayesian test for a shared causal variant between two association signals.

name: SMR / HEIDI
aim: Summary-data MR linking QTLs to traits; HEIDI tests for linkage vs pleiotropy.

name: TwoSampleMR / MR-PRESSO
aim: Two-sample MR with sensitivity analyses (MR-Egger, weighted median) and outlier correction.

name: S-PrediXcan / FUSION
aim: Transcriptome-wide association using expression prediction models and GWAS summary statistics.

name: COSMOS
aim: Connects phosphoproteomics, transcriptomics and metabolomics through a prior causal network.

name: Omics Integrator / OmicsNet
aim: Prize-collecting Steiner forest on interactomes; OmicsNet for web-based multi-omics networks.

name: ActivePathways / mitch / multiGSEA
aim: Pathway enrichment combining evidence across layers.

name: Open Targets Platform / Genetics
aim: Integrates genetics, omics, literature and drugs to score target–disease associations; locus-to-gene scores.

name: Nextflow + nf-core
aim: Portable, reproducible pipelines; nf-core provides peer-reviewed community pipelines for most omics.

name: Snakemake
aim: Rule-based, Python-friendly workflow engine with conda and container integration.

name: Bioconda / Docker / Apptainer
aim: Install bioinformatics software reproducibly and run it in containers on laptops or HPC.

name: Galaxy
aim: Point-and-click access to thousands of tools with full provenance and training material.

name: biomaRt / MyGene.info / UniProt ID mapping
aim: Map between gene, transcript, protein and external identifiers.

name: Quarto / Jupyter / R Markdown
aim: Literate analysis documents combining code, results and text.
